subject: general
question: How many silver medals has won by India at Tokyo Olympics 2020 (played in 2021)?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Two__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tokyo Olympics 2020

 
 
• United by Emotion is the “Motto” of the Olympics 2020.
 
• It is also known as the Games of the XXXII Olympiad.
 
• It was scheduled in Tokyo, Japan from 24 July to 9 August 2020.
 
• India won seven medals (1 Gold+2 Silver+4 Bronze) in the Tokyo Olympics 2020.
 
• The Olympics 2016 was held in Brazil while the upcoming Olympics 2024 will be held in Paris.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• The Olympic Games:

 
 
• The Olympic Games are normally held every four years.
 
• It is organized alternating between the Summer and Winter Games every two years in the four-year period.
 
• The first modern Olympic Games is organized in Athens in 1896.
 
• The headquarters of the International Olympic Committee is located in Lausanne, Switzerland.
